usedFor: Bannerbear generates your visuals, and Google Docs keeps a written log of them through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Image” in Bannerbear, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each finished image adds a line to a shared doc, so the team sees what was made.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can overwrite a tab, so pick add if you want to keep the history.
